fusions.name: Shoulder to the Yoke
fusions.desc: A heaving drag of the tines that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Harrowed Ground
fusions.desc: Drags a harrowed strip 7 tiles long that stays for 10 seconds. It deals 25 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rumination
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Goaded Too Far
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
